name: facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gnn_cost_model/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gn.create_CompilerGymDataset: create a CompilerGymDataset from a SQLite database filepath for supervised learning on compiler graphs

facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gn.run_main_entry: run the main entry point to download datasets, build a GNNEncoder model, and start training via absl flags

facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gn.test_run_train_smoke_test: test the GNN cost model training by running a smoke test with a small dataset on CPU

facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gn.test_gnn_cost_model_cli: test the GNN cost model CLI entry point using absl flags and sys.argv configuration
facebookresearch_compilergym/examples/gn.review_train_test_smoke: review the train_test module smoke test that validates GNN cost model training with pytest
